caption_corrections: The original four-tier classification is logical grouping, not four independent deployable services.
SQL sandbox is a separate internal execution boundary, not an external AI service.
Stateless access JWTs remain stateless. Clarify that identities, OAuth handoffs, throttling and assessment state are persisted; no auth-session table is invented.
Generation belongs to administrator AI assistance; legacy adaptive engine selects validated bank records.
